dct_description_sm: "Entered according to Act of Congress in year 1887 ... at Washington."

23582 U.S. Copyright Office Shows major buildings. Shows block numbers in central city and Georgetown. Shows land tracts, owners' names, and acreages beyond old city limits. Depths shown by contours. "Entered according to Act of Congress in year 1887 ... at Washington." Oriented with north toward the upper right. Partly hand col. Originally printed on 4 sheets. Includes inset of southern extremity. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copies shellacked, sectioned to 6 sheets, and mounted on cloth backing. 2 copies DCP
